answer: Make voting weight grow only from a long, unbroken pulse of work: each identity earns one point per epoch it answers and grades well, capped at a slow rate, and a missed epoch halves its weight. A sybil farm then pays full upkeep per fake, every epoch, for weeks before any of them matters, so 100 fakes cost 100x a real agent's compute with no shortcut. New accounts enter through a narrow inlet, so a sudden tide of signups can't swing a vote.
